ranks: Oracle EDHREC ranks 6746–6819 (the next 60 untriaged), and the cards waiting on effect:random-choice, built this batch (choose-random-card, choose-opponent's random, modal's random)

authored.name: Nissa, Vastwood Seer // Nissa, Sage Animist

blocked.name: Summon: Magus Sisters
blocked.why: random choice is built, but its chapters pick a mode at random as they go on the stack (before targets), and Defense! puts on a shield counter

blocked.name: Urza's Bauble
blocked.why: 'look at a card at random in target player's hand': choose-random-card reads only a graveyard

blocked.name: Rona, Herald of Invasion
blocked.why: the back face's 'exiles a card from their hand at random'

blocked.name: Crabomination
blocked.why: emerge, and 'a card at random from their hand'

blocked.name: River Song's Diary
blocked.why: chooses at random among the cards exiled with it, not a graveyard

blocked.name: Omenpath Journey
blocked.why: lands with different names, then a random one among the cards exiled with it

blocked.name: Kefka, Dancing Mad
blocked.why: the random exile is built; each owner of a spell cast this way losing life equal to its mana value isn't

blocked.name: Sin, Spira's Punishment
blocked.why: the random exile is built; 'if the exiled card is a land card, repeat this process' isn't

blocked.name: Tersa Lightshatter
blocked.why: the random exile is built; 'discard up to two cards, then draw that many' isn't

blocked.name: Chaos Defiler
blocked.why: choose one per opponent, then destroy one of the chosen at random

blocked.name: Wildfire Devils
blocked.why: the random player is built; 'that player exiles an instant or sorcery card from their graveyard' (their choice) has no unlinked exile — look-and-choose's 'exile' links it to the source as imprint does

blocked.name: Explosion of Riches
blocked.why: the random opponent is built; 'whenever a card is drawn this way' isn't

blocked.name: Vial Smasher the Fierce
blocked.why: the random opponent is built; 'that player or a planeswalker that player controls' (your choice) isn't

blocked.name: Indoraptor, the Perfect Hybrid
blocked.why: the random opponent is built; bloodthirst X isn't

blocked.name: Tibalt's Trickery
blocked.why: 'a nonland card with a different name than that spell': no name comparison with the countered spell

blocked.name: Arcum Dagsson
blocked.why: 'that player may search': a may another player answers isn't built, so a decline would still shuffle (docs/engine-gaps.md)

blocked.name: Black Cat, Cunning Thief
blocked.why: Look at the top nine of TARGET OPPONENT's library and exile two of them face down with a while-exiled play permission (any mana type): look-and-choose reads only your own library and has no exile-with-play-permission destination; impulse-exile only exiles the top N.

blocked.name: The Aesir Escape Valhalla
blocked.why: Chapter triggers carry no source stint (triggerChapters pushes no lastKnownRefs), so once the Saga leaves before II/III resolves, 'the exiled card' is unreachable: verified in a scratch run, bouncing it in response to II gave 0 counters (real card: its mana value), and III would leave the card in exile. A finished draft (passes while the Saga stays) is in staging/a/blocked-drafts/.

blocked.name: Field-Tested Frying Pan
blocked.why: 'Create a Food token, then create a 1/1 Halfling and attach this Equipment to it': attach's target 'created' is the FIRST token this resolution made (createdThisWay), i.e. the Food, so it can't reach the Halfling without reordering the creations.

blocked.name: Winnowing
blocked.why: 'For each player, you choose a creature that player controls', then each player sacrifices the rest not sharing a creature type with their chosen one: no per-player choice by the caster, and sharesCreatureTypeWith only reads a trigger object.

blocked.name: Memory Jar
blocked.why: Each player exiles their hand face down, draws seven, and at the next end step discards their hand and returns the cards exiled this way: no exile-hand effect, and no delayed trigger that returns each player's exiled-this-way cards.

blocked.name: Rune of Sustenance
blocked.why: 'As long as enchanted permanent is an Equipment, it has "Equipped creature has lifelink"': StaticAbility can grant keywords, activated and triggered abilities but not a static ability, and no affects scope reaches 'the creature the enchanted Equipment is attached to'.

blocked.name: Auspicious Starrix
blocked.why: Mutate (rule 702.140) isn't modeled, and its trigger counts the times it has mutated.

blocked.name: Rankle's Prank
blocked.why: Its ruling: each player chooses two cards without revealing them, then all are discarded at the same time; a scoped discard asks one player at a time and discards each as they answer (later players see earlier discards first) - the same need Professor Onyx was blocked on (sweep-3/B19). The life and sacrifice modes are fine; a draft is in staging/a/blocked-drafts/.

blocked.name: Archon of Coronation
blocked.why: 'As long as you're the monarch, damage doesn't cause you to lose life' (the damage is still dealt: lifelink, damage triggers and commander damage still count): no static or replacement for it.

blocked.name: Knowledge Pool
blocked.why: Imprint each player's top three linked to it, then 'whenever a player casts a spell from their hand, that player exiles it; if they do, they may cast a spell from among other cards exiled with this artifact' free: no exile-the-cast-spell effect, and cast-now can't offer another player's cast from the linked exile.

blocked.name: Brutal Hordechief
blocked.why: 'you choose how those creatures block' — no way for one player to declare another's blocks (the attack-trigger drain alone is expressible)

blocked.name: Collective Restraint
blocked.why: attackTax is a fixed { generic: number }; this one is X per attacker, X = basic land types among your lands (no domain amount either)

blocked.name: Legions to Ashes
blocked.why: no filter for 'all tokens that player controls with the same name as that permanent' (Maelstrom Pulse's gap)

blocked.name: Mutinous Massacre
blocked.why: no 'choose odd or even' choice nor a mana-value parity filter (the steal-all/untap/haste half is Insurrection's)

blocked.name: Ember Island Production
blocked.why: ruling: the copy's 'as [this creature] enters' abilities work; a token copy isn't asked its as-enters choices (§15, Ardyn's blocker) — otherwise castModal + create-token-copy would express it

blocked.name: Call to the Netherworld
blocked.why: madness is not modeled (discard-into-exile replacement + cast trigger)

blocked.name: Ajani, Sleeper Agent
blocked.why: compleated (fewer loyalty when life paid for {G/W/P}) is unmodeled, and −3 distributes three +1/+1 counters among up to three targets (only fixed 1/1 splits exist)

blocked.name: Dragonlord Silumgar
blocked.why: gain-control only has whileSource ('remains on the battlefield'); rulings say losing control of Silumgar ends the effect and a pre-resolution control loss means no steal

blocked.name: Killer Service
blocked.why: end-step 'you may pay {2} and sacrifice a token. If you do' is one combined optional cost; `may` takes mana/life/energy but no sacrifice, and each-player-may's options are alternatives, not a pair

blocked.name: Nexus of Becoming
blocked.why: ruling: the copy's 'as [this] enters' abilities work; a token copy isn't asked them (§15). Otherwise expressible: draw, then look-and-choose from hand to exile with a create-token-copy `then`

blocked.name: Soul Partition
blocked.why: exile's mayCast is the effect controller's cast-only permission; nothing gives the exiled card's owner a play permission while it stays exiled, nor taxes an opponent {2} for a spell cast that way

blocked.name: Eiganjo Dynastorian // Replenish
blocked.why: the prepare mechanic (becomes prepared, a castable copy of its spell in exile) isn't modeled

blocked.name: Elsha of the Infinite
blocked.why: castFromLibraryTop has no flash rider and castAsThoughFlash's filter can't say 'from the top of your library'; flash for every noncreature spell would be wrong

blocked.name: Canoptek Wraith
blocked.why: no way to choose a land you control and search for basic land cards with the same name as it

blocked.name: Dawnhand Dissident
blocked.why: Blight N as a cost isn't built, and casting creature spells from cards exiled with it by removing three counters from among your creatures has no permission or cost

blocked.name: Kinbinding
blocked.why: grantPtPerCount can't read the turnHistory 'entered' tally (creatures that entered under your control this turn, including ones since gone)

blocked.name: Cone of Cold
blocked.why: tap-all has no 'don't untap during their next untap step', and nothing installs 'until your next turn, creatures your opponents control enter tapped'

blocked.name: Xanathar, Guild Kingpin
blocked.why: no until-end-of-turn permission to look at and play the top card of a target opponent's library (with any-color spending)
